const LIMIT = 4;

class Counter {
  constructor() {
    this.value = 0;
  }

  inc() {
    this.value = this.clamp(this.value + 1);
  }

  dec() {
    this.value = this.clamp(this.value - 1);
  }

  clamp(value) {
    return Math.min(LIMIT, value);
  }

  reset() {
    this.value = 0;
  }

  read() {
    return this.value;
  }

  isZero() {
    return this.value === 0;
  }
}
